best_for: Social media managers needing to produce daily video content
Influencers and creators wanting to improve their engagement
Freelancers looking to offer short-form editing services
not_for: Those looking to edit feature films or long-form documentaries
Advanced editors already making high-retention shorts
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: No foundation needed. This course is highly accessible for beginners.

prerequisites.required: A smartphone (iOS/Android) and basic understanding of social media apps.
prerequisites.recommended: Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

system_requirements.hardware: Modern smartphone and/or a basic laptop.

prerequisites.not_required: Professional camera gear or heavy editing software experience.

overview.positioning: The fastest way to master the editing style that dominates modern social media.
overview.short_description: Learn to edit high-retention, vertical short-form videos using CapCut and Premiere Pro for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

key_facts.career_focus: Short-Form Video Editor, Social Media Manager

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Generate and animate engaging captions automatically
Sync cuts perfectly to trending audio
Optimize exports for maximum algorithm reach

why_now.industry_shift: Attention spans are shrinking; vertical short-form video (under 60 seconds) is the primary growth driver on every social platform.
why_now.ai_impact: CapCut's AI features (auto-captions, background removal) have democratized flashy editing, making speed the new currency.
why_now.business_demand: Every brand, real estate agent, and creator is desperately looking for editors who understand 'retention editing'.
why_now.career_opportunity: Short-form editors can secure monthly retainers easily, as clients need daily content.

learning_outcomes: HOOK: Edit the first 3 seconds to maximize viewer retention.
CUT: Perform rapid jump cuts and remove dead air.
ENGAGE: Add animated captions, sound effects, and b-roll pop-ups.
DELIVER: Export 9:16 video optimized for TikTok and Instagram.

stages.focus: Understanding retention and basic CapCut timeline editing.
Using Premiere Pro for advanced short-form edits.

supporting_tools.purpose: Advanced vertical editing and custom MOGRTs.

stages.name: Trending Audio / Scripting
stages.desc: Identifying a trend or scripting a hook-driven talking head.

stages.name: Rapid Cut
stages.desc: Chopping out all breaths and dead space.

stages.name: Captions & Pop-ups
stages.desc: Adding dynamic text and visual pattern interrupts.

stages.name: SFX & Music
stages.desc: Layering sound effects (whooshes, pops) to enhance visuals.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Need to showcase properties/products organically on Instagram.
business_use_cases.approach: Trending audio sync with fast cuts.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Podcaster needs to repurpose long-form audio into TikToks.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Auto-generating captions, removing backgrounds without green screens.
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Understanding the psychology of the hook.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Selecting which parts of the video are actually interesting.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Ensuring music licensing is appropriate for commercial use.

best_practices: Keep the most important action/text in the 'safe zones' (avoiding UI overlap).
Cut on action or on the beat.
Change the visual every 2-3 seconds to hold attention.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Treating a Reel like a YouTube video.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Start exactly on the most exciting frame/word. No 'Hey guys!'.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to turn around multiple videos per day that fit platform culture.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of high-retention, stylish vertical videos.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive raw footage -> Cut 5-10 shorts -> Review via Frame.io -> Final Delivery
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: An Instagram/TikTok page acting as a portfolio.

what_you_will_build: A 'Hormozi-style' talking head with dynamic captions

assessment.criteria: Hook strength, pacing, caption accuracy, and safe-zone compliance.

not_covered: Long-form narrative editing, complex color grading.

faq.question: Can I do this whole course on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes, but we highly recommend using CapCut Desktop or Premiere Pro for the advanced modules to increase your speed.

modules.module_purpose: Learn the mobile editing interface and the psychology of viewer retention.
what_you_will_learn: Jump cuts and removing dead space

lessons.what_is_taught: Importing footage, trimming, splitting, and the concept of 'retention editing'.
lessons.why_it_matters: Dead space kills retention; viewers will swipe away.
lessons.what_learner_does: Cuts a 2-minute ramble down to a punchy 30-second video.

lessons.what_is_taught: Importing trending audio and cutting exactly on the beat.
lessons.why_it_matters: The foundation of most lifestyle and transition trends.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a travel montage synced to a fast beat.

lessons.what_is_taught: Ensuring text and subjects aren't covered by the platform's UI.
lessons.why_it_matters: Amateur videos have text blocked by the caption or like buttons.
lessons.what_learner_does: Applies a safe-zone overlay and exports their video.

modules.hands_on_practice: Edit a fast-paced talking head video.
modules.assignment: Deliverable: 15-second talking head with no pauses.

modules.module_purpose: Add the 'sauce' that makes short-form videos viral and engaging.

lessons.what_is_taught: Generating, proofreading, and styling captions (the 'Hormozi' style).
lessons.why_it_matters: 80% of viewers watch social media with the sound off.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds bold, animated captions with highlighted words to a video.

lessons.what_is_taught: Adding pop-up emojis, B-roll, and keyframing slight digital zooms.
lessons.why_it_matters: Resets the viewer's attention every 3 seconds.
lessons.what_learner_does: Enhances their video with B-roll cutaways and digital zooms.

lessons.what_is_taught: Layering sound effects under visual pop-ups and transitions.
lessons.why_it_matters: SFX makes the video feel high-budget and energetic.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds whooshes to transitions and pops to text graphics.

modules.hands_on_practice: Take a raw podcast clip and turn it into a high-retention short.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to produce highly engaging social media videos.
